messages:
maya: Heads-up — multiple hosted inference customers reporting 5xx responses instead of 429s starting ~2026-03-15T09:10Z. High volume of customer tickets and some live-prod repros.
liam: Confirming. We see a surge in 5xx for token-check endpoints, spike coincides with quota-orchestrator latency rising.
support-jane: Customer says calls that should be rate-limited are failing completely. Example error: `502 Bad Gateway` with body "upstream error". They've escalated.
sre-bot: Alert triggered: quota-orch latency P95 > 2s for 3m; 5xx rate for /v1/infer/token-check rose to 4.1%.
carlos: Pasted relevant gateway logs:
```
[2026-03-15T09:10:23Z] gateway id=gw-1 req=abc123 route=/v1/infer/token-check -> quota-orch id=qo-7 status=504 err="context deadline exceeded"
[2026-03-15T09:10:23Z] quota-orch id=qo-7 -> limiter id=lim-2 upstream_err="timeout" code=504
[2026-03-15T09:10:23Z] gateway responded 502 to client id=abc123 body="upstream error"
```
maya: That matches what customers see. Important note: we should be returning 429 when the limiter decides it's over quota, not 5xx. Looks like quota-orch is returning 5xx when its dependency (limiter) times out.
liam: I pulled the quota-orch config from the canary we rolled last night. Snippet: 
```
{
  "on_dependency_timeout": "propagate_5xx",
  "retry_policy": "none",
  "fallback": null
}
```
support-jane: Oh — that "propagate_5xx" is new. Previous config mapped dependency timeouts to 429 so clients saw a client error rather than a platform error.
ops: Timeline: new routing + quota-orch config pushed 2026-03-15T03:12Z (reploy-bot shows canary 03:12), traffic increased at 09:07 and quota-orch hit a slow path causing limiter calls to time out. Gateway then propagated 5xx.
carlos: Quick repro (internal):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# observe 502 with logs showing quota-orch 504 upstream
```
maya: Escalation path: customers want clear 4xx for quota cases. We need immediate mitigation and a durable fix.
liam: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert the canary config to map dependency timeouts to 429; 2) add short-circuit in gateway to map quota-orch 5xx->429 for known quota routes for next 30m; 3) scale limiter pods and increase timeout thresholds. I'll open PR for config rollback.
deploy-bot: Rollback PR created: https://internal.redwood/repo/infra/PR/4821 (revert quota-orch canary mapping).
ops: I'm bumping limiter ASG from 8->12 and increasing grpc timeout between quota-orch and limiter from 1s -> 2.5s. Applying now.
sre-bot: Temporary gateway mapping applied: map 5xx from quota-orch -> 429 for /v1/infer/token-check and /v1/embeddings/token-check.
maya: After the mapping + scale, customer 5xx rate dropped to 0.6% in 10m window, tickets updated.
support-jane: Customers notified: "We applied a mitigation to ensure rate limits return 429 while we investigate root cause. We're working on a permanent fix." :thumbsup:
liam: Root cause analysis (preliminary): a change in quota-orch error-handling policy (canary) made dependency timeouts propagate as 5xx. Under load, limiter hit a slow GC/CPU stall in a specific instance causing timeouts; instead of translating to 429, quota-orch propagated the 5xx.
carlos: Evidence: limiter pod lim-2 CPU show spike then long STW pauses around 09:09; limiter logs show repeated GC cycles and increased latency.
liam: Follow-ups: 1) revert canary (done), 2) add unit test and e2e to ensure dependency timeouts are mapped to 429 for quota checks, 3) add alert that flags when quota-orch returns >0.5% 5xx classified as "quota" within 5m, 4) postmortem with timeline and customer impact. I'll own 2+3.
maya: Ops to run a targeted postmortem and include mitigation timeline and customer ids. Also let's add a runbook step: on quota-orch dep timeout -> map to 429 unless explicit error.
sre-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-0342, assigned to liam and ops.
ops: Noted, will follow-up on limiter pod investigation (heap tuning, GC settings).
support-jane: Customer follow-ups scheduled, will keep them updated.
maya: Good work. Action items: liam PR for e2e tests, ops adjust limiter JVM flags and scale; carlos to write postmortem draft. We'll reconvene after postmortem draft. :eyes:
